title: Assistant Professor of Anatomy
content: Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of Assistant Professor in the Department of Anatomy, Gomal Medical College, Dera Ismail Khan.
excerpt: One post of Assistant Professor (Anatomy) on regular basis.
how_to_apply: Submit the online form, then send attested copies of degrees, PMDC registration and the bank voucher to the Principal's office.

title: Medical Officer (Emergency)
content: Applications are invited for Medical Officers in the Emergency Department of the attached teaching hospital on contract basis.
excerpt: Three contract posts of Medical Officer.
how_to_apply: Send a CV with attested documents by post to the Medical Superintendent.

title: Junior Clerk
content: Applications are invited for the post of Junior Clerk in the college administration.
